title: ICON Concerts Presents Gary Owen: No Hard Feelings Tour
seo_title: Gary Owen: No Hard Feelings Tour at Gillioz Theatre
description: Comedian Gary Owen brings his No Hard Feelings Tour to the Gillioz Theatre, with observational humor and storytelling drawn from his personal life, military service and everyday absurdities. It is for ages 12 and up, with reserved seating, VIP Meet & Greet and VIP Merchandise packages available, and no outside food or drink permitted. The show is Thursday, December 3, 2026 at 8:00 PM at 325 Park Central, E Springfield, Missouri.
